# CoTracker3 (vendored)

`cotracker/` and `LICENSE.md` copied unchanged from facebookresearch/co-tracker, via the team's checkout at
`/project/spencer/ZipMo-Poke2Video/third_party/co-tracker` (the copy used to build koala_train_v2).
License: CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial; fine for this class project).
Weights: `scaled_offline.pth` from https://huggingface.co/facebook/cotracker3, downloaded on first use to the
torch hub cache (see `src/tracking.py`).
